name: Dogs In Water
tagline: Safer, happier days in the water.
description: Practical, safety-first guides to swimming, beaches, lakes, boating and pools with your dog, plus the ear, skin and coat care that keeps water days fun.

pillars.name: Water Safety
pillars.blurb: Life jackets, currents, toxic algae, heatstroke, water first aid and the checklist to run before every swim.

pillars.name: Learning to Swim
pillars.blurb: Teaching puppies, nervous dogs and seniors to enjoy the water, and which breeds should stay in the shallows.

pillars.name: Beach Days
pillars.blurb: Packing, salt water, sand, heat and beach manners, so a day at the ocean ends with a tired, happy dog.

pillars.name: Lakes & Rivers
pillars.blurb: Fresh water has its own hazards. What to pack and what to watch for at the lake.

pillars.name: Boating & Paddling
pillars.blurb: Boats, kayaks and paddleboards: life jackets, ramps, seasickness and getting your dog back aboard.

pillars.name: Pools
pillars.blurb: Backyard pool safety, chlorine, exits and the toys that make pool time fun.

pillars.name: After the Swim
pillars.blurb: Rinsing, drying, ears, skin and coat: the care that keeps water fun from turning into a vet visit.

pillars.name: Games & Sports
pillars.blurb: Water games, dock diving, surfing and photographing your dog in action.

pillars.name: Snow & Ice
pillars.blurb: Frozen lakes, winter swims and snow play: water in its coldest form.
